sources.snippet: Model Card for Pinal: Toward De Novo Protein Design from Natural Language Pinal is an advanced protein design framework that translates human design intent into novel protein sequences. It utilizes a two-stage process: first generating protein structures from language instructions, then designing sequences based on those structures.
